label: def:continuous_on
title: Continuous on a set
statement: A function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ between topological spaces is \emph{continuous on} a set $s \subseteq \alpha$ if for every $x \in s$, $f$ is continuous within $s$ at $x$, i.e., the filter map of $f$ along the neighborhood filter of $x$ restricted to $s$ tends to $f(x)$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{ContinuousOn}.
